title: BDx Indonesia
bottom_line:
BDx Indonesia (PT Starone Mitra Telekomunikasi) has been 75% owned since 2 June 2022 by I Squared Capital's BDx (through BDX Asia Data Center Holdings, Singapore), with Indosat at 17.5% and its subsidiary Lintasarta at 7.5%, and Bloomberg reported in February 2026 that I Squared was weighing a sale of BDx at about US$2 billion.
All of its power is PLN grid supply under a 2 June 2026 contract for about 1.2 GW (CGK4 788, now 845 MVA, through a new 150 kV substation PLN is building at Jatiluhur; CGK3A about 60 MVA; CGK5 385 MVA), while the "renewable-powered" Jatiluhur label rests only on unsigned hydropower talks with Perum Jasa Tirta II, and West Java stopped the 640 MW CGK4 expansion over missing AMDAL and PBG permits and its draw on Jatiluhur reservoir water.
Acset (Astra group) built the CGK3A and CGK4 shells and Bank Permata, BCA and KB Bank lead its debt (US$320 million, April 2026), but no public source names a tenant other than its own shareholders, an equipment maker or a commissioner.

entities.name: BDx Indonesia
entities.what: Data-centre joint venture since 2 Jun 2022 (BDx 75%, Indosat 17.5%, Lintasarta 7.5%), built on SMT, the Indosat company that received Indosat's and Lintasarta's data centres in Apr 2022. Runs CGK1-CGK5 around Jakarta plus ten former Indosat colocation/edge sites; MNC Sekuritas puts live capacity at ~102 MW (Sep 2026). Office: Intiland Tower 19th floor, Jl. Jend. Sudirman Kav 32, Jakarta.

entities.name: BDX Asia Data Center Holdings
entities.legal_name: BDX Asia Data Center Holdings Pte. Ltd.
entities.what: BDx holding company (Pte. Ltd., so Singapore-registered) that bought 75% of PT Starone Mitra Telekomunikasi from Indosat in 2022 for US$227.5 mn, US$187.5 mn at closing and the rest over five years.

entities.name: BDx Data Centers
entities.what: Singapore-based data-centre group (Big Data Exchange), a portfolio company of I Squared Capital; operates in Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong and Taiwan (18 data centres and 50 edge sites in its Apr 2026 release). CEO Mayank Srivastava; told DealStreetAsia in Jul 2026 it is open to an IPO.

entities.name: I Squared Capital
entities.what: Independent global infrastructure investor founded in 2012, about US$60 bn under management; owns BDx. Bloomberg reported in Feb 2026 that it was weighing a ~US$2 bn sale of BDx (seen in search results only; no deal found by Oct 2026).

entities.name: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison
entities.what: Listed Indonesian telco (IOH), 65.6% held by Ooredoo Hutchison Asia. Put its data centres into SMT, sold 75% of SMT to BDx in 2022 and its ten colocation/edge sites to SMT in Dec 2023; head office at Jl. Medan Merdeka Barat No. 21, Jakarta.

entities.name: Lintasarta
entities.what: ICT and network company founded in 1988, a subsidiary of PT Indosat Tbk; holds 7.5% of BDx Indonesia after contributing its data centres in 2022. President Director & CEO Armand Hermawan since Apr 2026.

entities.name: Ooredoo Hutchison Asia
entities.what: Holding venture of Qatar's Ooredoo and CK Hutchison's Hutchison Asia Telecom Group; owns 65.6% of Indosat.

entities.name: BDx CGK1 (Central Jakarta)
entities.what: 8 MW IT, operational, at Jl. Medan Merdeka Barat No. 21, Gambir. That is Indosat's head-office address, so CGK1 most likely sits in Indosat's HQ building (our inference from the two addresses).

entities.name: BDx CGK2 (Technopark BSD)
entities.what: 3.4 MW IT, operational, Taman Tekno Blok D No.08 in Technopark BSD; Baxtel lists it as the former 'Lintasarta Technopark Data Center', built 2016.

entities.name: BDx CGK3/3A 'AI Campus 1' (Cilandak)
entities.what: 26 MW IT on a 60 MVA PLN supply, operational, Jl. T.B. Simatupang Raya Kav.10. CGK3A (greenfield, 15 MW planned, 14,127 m2) broke ground Apr 2023 and was topped off Dec 2024; BDx says the AI-focused CGK3 went live Sep 2025; liquid-cooled, with 7.1 MW of NVIDIA GB200 delivered in 143 days. Hosts the BDx IX PoP and an APJII IIX node.

entities.name: BDx CGK4 'AI Campus 2' (Jatiluhur)
entities.what: 640 MW IT planned on 111,000 m2 (180,000 m2 GFA) with 845 MVA from PLN, ~5 km from Jatiluhur Dam. Phase 1 built in 75 days (Jul 2024; MNC: 72 MW live). Six-building AI Campus 2 broke ground 22 Sep 2026 (Building 1 = 120 MW, first phase contracted to an unnamed customer for early 2027); West Java halted it around 30 Sep-2 Oct 2026 because the AMDAL and PBG permits were not issued and over its use of Jatiluhur water.

entities.name: BDx CGK5 'AI Campus 3' (Suryacipta)
entities.what: In development at Kawasan Industri Suryacipta I6-7B2, Ciampel: 290 MW IT on BDx's page (100 MW when announced Nov 2022; MNC: +110 MW under construction), 385 MVA from PLN, 50,000 m2 site bought from PT Suryacipta Swadaya.

entities.name: Ex-Indosat colocation and edge sites (10)
entities.city: Jakarta, Surabaya, Batam, Medan, Makassar, Bandung, Semarang
entities.what: Ten carrier-neutral colocation and edge sites bought from Indosat for IDR 2,625 bn (agreements signed 18 Dec 2023, announced 9 Jan 2024), connected to six domestic and five international subsea cables; MNC counts ~30 MW across BDx's edge campuses.

entities.name: PLN
entities.what: State power utility. Signed a 30 MVA PPA with BDx Indonesia through PLN UID Jakarta Raya (Jun 2025) and a PJBTL on 2 Jun 2026 for ~1.2 GW across CGK4, CGK3A and CGK5.

entities.name: GI 150 kV Jatiluhur Baru
entities.what: New 150 kV substation PLN is building to feed BDx's CGK4 campus; no contractor or equipment maker named.

entities.name: Perum Jasa Tirta II
entities.what: State firm that runs the Jatiluhur reservoir and the dam's 187.5 MW hydropower plant. BDx says it is exploring a hydropower arrangement with it for CGK4; no signed deal or PJT II statement found.

entities.name: PDAM Purwakarta
entities.what: Purwakarta regency water utility with a 3,000 L/s allocation from the Jatiluhur reservoir; West Java's governor said CGK4's cooling water would come through it (about 14% of that allocation).

entities.name: Acset
entities.what: Listed building contractor controlled by PT United Tractors Tbk (Astra group) through PT Karya Supra Perkasa (91.17%); shell-and-core contractor for BDx CGK3A and CGK4.

entities.name: ATMC Pump Services
entities.what: Acset's 100% concrete-pump rental subsidiary; its profile lists 'BDX Data Center' among projects it supplied.

entities.name: Schneider Electric
entities.what: Equipment maker; its 2021 case study covers Galaxy VX UPS, Uniflair cooling, APC racks, NetBotz, PowerLogic and EcoStruxure at Lintasarta's three Tier III data centres (sites not named).

entities.name: NVIDIA
entities.what: GPU maker. Certified CGK4 under its DGX-Ready Data Center program (Apr 2025); 7.1 MW of GB200 capacity was commissioned at CGK3A in 2025; its Feb 2024 AI-cloud MoU with Indosat and Lintasarta was to run in BDx data centres.

entities.name: Bank Permata
entities.what: Lender to BDx Indonesia since Jan 2024; a mandated lead arranger of the US$320 mn loan closed 1 Apr 2026.

entities.name: BCA
entities.what: Lender to BDx Indonesia since Jan 2024; a mandated lead arranger of the US$320 mn loan closed 1 Apr 2026.

entities.name: KB Bank (formerly Bank KB Bukopin)
entities.what: Named 'Bank Bukopin' in BDx's Jan 2024 release and 'KB Bank' in its Apr 2026 release; treated as one bank after its rebrand (our inference).

entities.name: King & Wood
entities.what: Law firm reported (search result only; the law.asia page returns 403) to have advised BDx on the US$320 mn syndicated loan.

entities.name: NeutraDC
entities.what: Telkom Indonesia's data-centre arm. IX-interconnection partner of BDx Indonesia since a Jan 2024 MoU; Phase I (Aug 2024) linked BDx CGK3/3A with NeutraDC Cikarang across a planned 108 sites.

entities.name: Telkom Indonesia
entities.what: State telco; parent of NeutraDC.

entities.name: APJII
entities.what: Indonesia's ISP association, which runs the IIX exchange; added an IIX node at BDx CGK3A in Jan 2025 (an MoU renewal dated 9 Sep 2026 appears in a search result only; its page did not load).

entities.name: Suryacipta Swadaya
entities.what: Developer of Suryacipta City of Industry, Karawang; sold BDx Indonesia the 12-acre CGK5 plot (Nov 2022).

entities.name: Surya Semesta Internusa
entities.what: Listed parent of PT Suryacipta Swadaya.

entities.name: West Java Provincial Government
entities.what: Under Governor Dedi Mulyadi, ordered CGK4 construction stopped (inspection 28 Sep, halt reported 30 Sep-2 Oct 2026) until AMDAL and PBG permits are issued; also questioned the campus's water use.

entities.name: Purwakarta Regency Environmental Agency
entities.what: Regency environmental agency reviewing the CGK4 AMDAL (Jakarta Post via ANN, 1 Oct 2026).

entities.name: Agus Hartono Wijaya
entities.what: President Director & CEO of BDx Indonesia since Dec 2022; earlier ~20 years in business development, marketing and operations, including a country-manager role in hospitality (company not named).

entities.name: Mayank Srivastava
entities.what: CEO of BDx Data Centers (Chief Development Officer in May 2022); Interim President Director of BDx Indonesia from Jun 2022 until Agus Hartono Wijaya's appointment in Dec 2022.

entities.name: Braham Singh
entities.what: CEO of BDx when the Indonesian JV was signed and completed (May-Jun 2022).

entities.name: Sujit Panda
entities.what: Chief Operating Officer of BDx Data Centers; gave BDx's statement on the APJII IIX node at CGK3A (Jan 2025).

entities.name: Gautam Bhandari
entities.what: Co-founder, Managing Partner and Global CIO of I Squared Capital; attended the Jan 2024 BDx Indonesia-NeutraDC MoU signing.

entities.name: Sadek Wahba
entities.what: Founder, Chairman and Managing Partner of I Squared Capital.

entities.name: Vikram Sinha
entities.what: President Director & CEO of Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison and a commissioner of Lintasarta; spoke for Indosat on each BDx Indonesia deal from 2022 to 2024.

entities.name: Arya Damar
entities.what: President Director of Lintasarta when the JV was formed (2022).

entities.name: Bayu Hanantasena
entities.what: Lintasarta CEO at the Feb 2024 NVIDIA AI-cloud deal.

entities.name: Armand Hermawan
entities.what: President Director & CEO of Lintasarta since Apr 2026.

entities.name: Adi Priyanto
entities.what: PLN Director of Retail & Commerce; PLN's spokesman on the Jun 2026 PJBTL with BDx.

links.detail: A 30 MVA power purchase agreement with PLN UID Jakarta Raya (19 Jun 2025) for CGK3A and CGK4.
